description: Converts a number between units of length, mass, volume, area, speed, time, data size, pressure, energy and temperature. Returns the converted value and the normalized unit names. Use it when exact conversions matter (e.g. mi to km, GiB to GB, F to C). Limits: no currency conversion; units must be in the same dimension.

from.description: unit, e.g. mi, kg, f, gib

name: unit_convert
title: Unit Converter
